Publish.LongDescription:
# Station Suitability Overlay
Renders a vanilla-style infoview heatmap that scores every 32 m tile for transit station placement, so you can see at a glance where a new bus stop or metro station would serve the most people.
## Scoring
Each tile is scored with a weighted multi-criteria formula over a configurable catchment (350 m bus / 600 m metro by default):
- **Demand** — residents within the catchment - **Jobs** — workplaces within the catchment - **Coverage penalty** — existing stops of the selected mode reduce the score nearby, avoiding redundant stations - **Accessibility** — road network density around the tile
The best tiles reach the top of the green-yellow-red gradient; how large that top share is (1-20%, default 5%) is configurable. Bus and Metro presets ship with sensible defaults, and all weights and radii are adjustable in Options.
## Usage
Open the infoview menu and select **Station Suitability**. The brightest red tiles are the best locations for a new stop. Tune mode preset, weights and radii under Options > Station Suitability Overlay; the overlay recalculates automatically when stops change or settings move.
